title: Goal and task views show in-between progress: started, partly proved, waiting on TJ's review

fields.why: TJ: 'agents have done things that dont look like they have progress'. Goal progress counts only done/total tickets.

text: TJ: started or pending-review work must show in the Whole project view and goal/task views. Goal.progress is {done,total,blocked} (Snapshot.swift ~L50, from genlock CLI in lib/). Surface: in_progress, partly proved (2 of 3), only eye:/manual: checks left (waiting on TJ), open genlock review. Views: InspectorView, DashboardView, SessionStrip goal chip. Parent has uncommitted edits in Snapshot.swift/SessionStrip.swift/CoreTests.swift: keep them, commit by path. Check claims (T-RBSVN edited InspectorView).

Also handle swaps: a swap now logs op 'handoff' on each task (owner cleared, handed_off {from,goal,at}) until the fresh session starts it (T-VS846). Progress views must show a handed-off task as carried over, not orphaned or zero.
